company.name: Apex
company.shortDescription: Apex designs and manufactures satellite buses tailored for various space missions.
company.description: Apex designs and manufactures small satellites tailored for various space missions. The company focuses on streamlining satellite production by integrating modular hardware and standardized software systems. Apex offers platforms that support Earth observation, communications, and scientific research applications. Its approach emphasizes scalable manufacturing processes to meet the growing demand for satellite deployment. Apex collaborates with clients to customize satellite configurations based on mission-specific requirements.

productsAndServices.description: A configurable satellite bus family for LEO and GEO missions, supporting payloads up to 150 kg in LEO and up to 120 kg in a standard GEO ESPA configuration.
productsAndServices.name: Aries

productsAndServices.description: A scalable manufacturing system that helps partners establish local, high-rate production of Apex satellite buses using standardized facilities, processes, training, and production software.
